lines.en: Hello, I am calling about the room.
Yes, it is still free. Are you a student?
No, I work at the hospital. I start at seven.
That is fine. The rent is four thousand a month.
lines.tr: Sorun değil. Kira ayda dört bin.

lines.en: Does that include water and electricity?
lines.tr: Buna su ve elektrik dahil mi?

lines.en: Water yes, electricity no. We share that.
lines.tr: Su evet, elektrik hayır. Onu paylaşıyoruz.

lines.en: Can I come and see it this evening?
Of course. Come after six and bring your questions.
lines.tr: Tabii. Altıdan sonra gelin, sorularınızı da getirin.

questions.q: Why is the caller phoning?
Where does the caller work?
How much is the rent?
questions.note: "The rent is four thousand a month."

questions.q: What is included in the rent?
When can the caller visit?

lines.en: Hello. My package has not arrived.
Can you give me the number, please?
It is four seven two nine.
I see it. The driver came on Tuesday but nobody was home.
lines.tr: Görüyorum. Sürücü salı günü gelmiş ama evde kimse yokmuş.

lines.en: I was at work. Can he come again on Saturday?
Yes, but somebody must sign for it.
My neighbor can sign. Is that possible?
Yes. I will write a note on the order.

questions.q: What is Sibel's problem?
Why did the driver not leave it?
questions.note: "The driver came on Tuesday but nobody was home."

questions.q: When does Sibel want the driver to come?
What is necessary before the driver leaves the package?
Who will sign?

lines.en: Good morning. I would like a library card.
Do you live in this city?
Yes, I moved here two months ago.
lines.tr: Evet, iki ay önce buraya taşındım.

lines.en: Then I need a document with your address.
lines.tr: O zaman adresinizin olduğu bir belge gerekiyor.

lines.en: I have an electricity bill. Is that enough?
That is perfect. You can borrow five books.
lines.tr: Bu harika. Beş kitap ödünç alabilirsiniz.

lines.en: For how long?
Three weeks, and you can extend it online.

questions.q: What does Efe want?
When did he move to the city?
What document does he show?
How many books can he borrow?
How long can he keep them?
questions.note: "Three weeks, and you can extend it online."

lines.en: The weather is beautiful. Shall we walk by the sea?
lines.tr: Hava çok güzel. Deniz kenarında yürüyelim mi?

lines.en: I wanted to see the new film this evening.
lines.tr: Bu akşam yeni filmi izlemek istiyordum.

lines.en: The film is on until Thursday. The sun is not.
lines.tr: Film perşembeye kadar var. Güneş yok.

lines.en: That is true. But I am quite tired today.
We can walk for half an hour and then have tea.
lines.tr: Yarım saat yürür, sonra çay içeriz.

lines.en: All right. But you buy the tea.
Agreed. I will meet you at the gate at five.
See you there. Do not be late again.

questions.q: What does Ilker suggest?
What did Yasemin want to do?
questions.note: "I wanted to see the new film."

questions.q: What is Ilker's argument?
questions.note: "The film is on until Thursday. The sun is not."

questions.q: What do they agree to do?
questions.note: "We can walk for half an hour and then have tea."

questions.q: Where do they meet?
questions.note: "I will meet you at the gate at five."

lines.en: My phone fell and the screen is broken.
Does it still work?
Yes, but I cannot read anything on the left side.
lines.tr: Evet ama sol tarafta hiçbir şey okuyamıyorum.

lines.en: We can change the screen. It costs two thousand.
That is a lot. How long does it take?
lines.tr: Bu çok fazla. Ne kadar sürüyor?

lines.en: Two hours. You can wait or come back later.
lines.tr: İki saat. Bekleyebilirsiniz ya da sonra gelebilirsiniz.

lines.en: I will come back at four. Is my photographs safe?
Yes, we do not touch anything inside the phone.
lines.tr: Evet, telefonun içindeki hiçbir şeye dokunmuyoruz.

questions.q: What is wrong with the phone?
Does the phone still work?
options: Yes, but part of the screen is unreadable
questions.note: "I cannot read anything on the left side."

questions.q: How much does the repair cost?
How long must Aysun wait for the repair?
What does the technician say about her photographs?
questions.note: "We do not touch anything inside the phone."
